sources.title: Ryzen AI Software — Ryzen AI Software 1.8.0 documentation - AMD
sources.snippet: Ryzen AI Software # AMD Ryzen™ AI Software includes the tools and runtime libraries for optimizing and deploying AI inference on AMD Ryzen™ AI powered PCs. Ryzen AI software enables applications to run on the neural processing unit (NPU) built in the AMD XDNA™ architecture, as well as on the integrated GPU.

sources.title: Nvidia deep dives Vera CPU for AI data centers — SPEC CPU 2026 ...
sources.snippet: In the Vera white paper, Nvidia shared benchmarks for SPEC CPU 2026, specifically the integer suite from SPECrate, against AMD's Epyc 9755, with both chips running in a dual-socket configuration.

sources.title: Nvidia unveils Vera, an 88-core Arm CPU for AI and analytics racks
sources.snippet: Alongside the chip, Nvidia is introducing a liquid-cooled rack that aggregates 256 Vera CPUs, signaling its intent to compete for CPU sockets in large-scale AI and data analytics deployments.
